units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p s

# Read structure
read_data Al_bulk.data

replicate 5 5 5

variable lz equal lz
variable new_lz equal 3*v_lz

# Add vacuum in z-direction (triple the box size in z)
change_box all z final 0 ${new_lz} units box

# Define potential
